lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li2Mn4FeO8 is tetragonal, space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a 15-atom unit cell and four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies tetrahedral FeO4 and LiO4 environments, while Mn is six-coordinate to oxygen and O is four-coordinate with mixed Fe, Li, and Mn neighbors. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows corner-sharing between FeO4 and LiO4 tetrahedra, and both corner- and edge-sharing between Mn-centered 6-vertex polyhedra and FeO4 tetrahedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 15 sites.
